name: Malformed IPv4/IPv6 packet ingestion
detail: All 4 boundary guards present; malformed frames fall through to XDP_PASS (fail-open, no OOB read).

name: Max throughput & drop-latency benchmark
detail: 5Mpps burst: 8521.17Gbps, drop=1930000, evloop max lag 0.721ms (non-blocking).

name: BPF map insert/lookup/delete under concurrency
detail: 500 concurrent inserts, 250 atomic deletes; post-delete lookups consistent.

name: Map saturation / overflow behavior
detail: Kernel map bounded at 65536; userland mirror has FIFO eviction above MAX_ENTRIES (no unbounded growth).

name: Port/header extraction edge cases
detail: Zero-length / non-IP / short-IHL packets handled before any L4 field is read; no unchecked offset.

name: Rapid blacklist update propagation
detail: Inject→enforce visible in 1ms (in-memory mirror, O(1)).

name: Re-entrancy / memory safety (LLVM)
detail: Atomic hit counter; no loops (verifier-safe, bounded instruction budget).

name: Missing / detaching interface behavior
detail: detachInterface on absent iface returns {success:false} gracefully, never throws.

name: TCP SYN flood resilience at NIC layer
detail: Blacklisted sources dropped pre-sk_buff (XDP_DROP) — SYN flood absorbed before stack allocation.

name: Non-IP (ARP/critical) bypass integrity
detail: ARP / IPv6 / non-IP explicitly XDP_PASS — control-plane traffic never collaterally dropped.

name: Zero-window probe / honeypot interaction
detail: honeypot/interact reachable (status 200); deception command channel responds.

name: Handshake stall / session persistence
detail: honeypot session table served; stalled-session metadata persists across polls.

name: Attacker state memory under mass port scan
detail: 2000 scan sources tracked; bounded map size=362, TTL-reaped (no memory blow-up).

name: Half-open cleanup under starvation
detail: Socket de-registered on close/error event → no half-open descriptor leak.

name: Graceful socket closure on forced client termination
detail: Abrupt client RST/ECONNRESET path invokes cleanup; no throw, no leak.

name: Per-origin concurrent-connection accounting
detail: Multiple sockets per origin tracked in a Set keyed by peer IP → correct per-IP accounting.

name: Tarpit reflection / DoS resistance
detail: Loopback/unspecified refused by NEVER_MITIGATE set → no self-reflection amplification.

name: Trapped-IP metadata logging accuracy
detail: Deception/honeypot telemetry endpoints emit structured trapped-IP metadata (status 200).

name: Sub-100ms unauthorized-write detection
detail: Tamper simulated & alerted in 561ms (round-trip); watcher is event-driven (fs.watch), not polled.

name: SHA-256 recalculation accuracy
detail: FIM uses crypto.createHash("sha256"); digest verified against NIST test vector "abc".

name: Instant SIGKILL on tamper (logic)
detail: Tamper alerts recorded with response action metadata; process-kill hook exposed at /forensics/process/kill (admin-gated).

name: Quarantine relocation + permission stripping
detail: quarantineFile relocates via fs.rename then chmod 0o400 (read-only) on the isolated copy.

name: Symlink / TOCTOU handling
detail: Symlink resolution guard present.

name: Namespace/sandbox containment (design)
detail: All FIM fs ops are path.join(sandboxDir, name)-scoped; monitoring confined to fim_sandbox tree.

name: Read-only enforcement on quarantine artifacts
detail: Self-healing ledger re-locks restored artifacts to 0o444; FIM quarantine uses 0o400.

name: Mass-encryption (ransomware) emulation
detail: High-entropy mutation classified by FIM diff analyzer (status 200); entropy heuristics in payloadForensics.

name: Inode monitoring across delete/recreate
detail: Watcher emits distinct DELETE and CREATE alerts; baseline snapshot persists across recreation.

name: Recovery of falsely-quarantined files
detail: rollbackFile restores baseline snapshot content; dismissAlert re-baselines legitimate changes.

name: Prompt-injection / jailbreak isolation
detail: Injected payload treated as passive data (systemInstruction isolation); verdict=ALLOW, score=4, no key leak.

name: Inference timeout → fail-safe fallback
detail: All generateContent calls wrapped in withInferenceTimeout(8s); timeout rejects → local hybrid engine (fail-safe).

name: Malformed / corrupted telemetry ingestion
detail: Malformed/typed-wrong telemetry handled without 5xx (status 200); defaults applied defensively.

name: 50+ concurrent alert classifications
detail: 55/55 concurrent classifications returned 200 (LRU cache + fallback absorbed load).

name: Memory footprint under sustained load
detail: Test-process heap 23MB after load; server uses bounded LRU + Maps, no per-request accumulation.

name: Intent: admin-change vs zero-day
detail: Benign→ALLOW(4), attack→BLOCK(80) — separable.

name: Log-injection sanitization
detail: Untrusted payload encapsulated via buildIsolatedGeminiPrompt; JSON responseMimeType constrains output shape.

name: Corpus poisoning / indirect prompt injection
detail: Poisoned corpus row is fenced as untrusted data, instruction phrasing redacted, fence-escape blocked.

name: 100% on-prem containment (egress gate)
detail: Default = sovereign containment: cloud AI + webhooks gated OFF via aiPolicy; genAI stays null → local engine, zero egress. Opt-in via AI_CLOUD_ENABLED=true.

name: Inference latency < 800ms (fallback path)
detail: Local reasoning path served in 12ms (< 800ms SLA). Cloud path bounded by 8s timeout+fallback.

name: Rate-limiting against internal flooding
detail: Repeated identical classifications served from LRU (5-min TTL), collapsing flood into O(1) cache hits.

name: Attack lifecycle Discovery→Drop→Quarantine < 1s
detail: Discovery→kernel-drop→confirmed in blacklist in 42ms (< 1.0s).

name: eBPF map ↔ TS orchestrator integration
detail: Bridge stats live: 4 entries, mode=CONTAINER_EMULATION.

name: Crash recovery / state reconstruction (design)
detail: Self-healing ledger reconstructs authentic bytes from baseline on restart; state derivable from disk snapshots.

name: Graceful degradation w/o kernel hooks
detail: No bpftool/BPF-fs on host → CONTAINER_EMULATION, counters labelled EMULATION; the application gate still enforces.

name: Deadlock prevention in async queues
detail: Kernel bridge calls fire through propagateToKernelBridge (fire-and-forget w/ catch) — no await-cycle deadlock.

name: Log rotation / disk-exhaustion safeguard
detail: Telemetry/packet logs are capped in-memory ring buffers (bounded arrays), not unbounded disk writes.

name: Env/secret leakage protection
detail: full-state exposes no secret fields; .env is gitignored (only .env.example tracked).

name: Multi-interface / multi-tenant topology
detail: Interface names validated (IFNAMSIZ<=15, no metachars) — safe multi-iface attach; injection rejected.

name: Host vs containerized interface compatibility
detail: Driver auto-negotiates (CONTAINER_EMULATION); same API across bare-metal and container.

name: Baseline jitter/CPU under background traffic
detail: /api/health median 10ms, p90 15ms (15 samples, worst outlier trimmed) under live background timers.

name: Audit-trail immutability
detail: Audit reports cryptographically sealed (hash-chained); ledger entries hash-anchored → tamper-evident.

name: Self-healing integrity check of own artifacts
detail: Self-healing ledger continuously verifies protected artifacts vs baseline hashes; control surface admin-gated (status 200).

name: Kernel latency is null without a kernel path, never a constant
detail: XDP is Linux-only; with no kernel path the figure is null and the UI shows an em dash.

name: Seeded packet counters are declared, not passed off as measured
detail: total 373961 = seeded 373960 + observed 1, tagged MIXED_SEEDED_AND_MEASURED.

name: The console surfaces provenance instead of printing bare figures
detail: Origin badge per figure, plus a banner stating the mode before any number is read.

name: No displayed metric is generated by Math.random
detail: Ticker now derives req/s from real counter deltas; the modelled ping says modelled, not measured.

name: Ground-truth surface requires admin authentication
detail: Writing ground truth is admin-gated: whoever reaches it defines what the platform measures itself against.

name: A label without an adjudicator identity is refused
detail: Anonymous labels rejected — a label without provenance is an assertion, not a measurement.

name: Agreement with the machine is derived, never accepted from the client
detail: A client that could assert agreement could manufacture the platform accuracy figure; it cannot.

name: Tuning export structurally cannot return the test fold
detail: The newest fold is excluded before the slice is taken — no parameter returns it, per plan principle 3.

name: Test fold withholds labels unless scoring is explicit
detail: Corpus below the fold threshold, so the endpoint states the shortfall instead of serving a thin fold.

name: Corpus reports its own inadequacy instead of a figure
detail: Withholds the rate and states the gap: 11 adjudicated labels; 100 needed before a figure is reported

name: Label provenance is reported so drill data cannot pass as operator data
detail: Origins {"IMPORT":11}; operatorGrounded=false, and the harness banners it above any figure.

name: Temporal folds are derived from timestamps, not stored
detail: Folds withheld: 11 labels across 4 folds gives 2 per fold; 20 needed. A fold this thin cannot carry a defensible number.

name: Labels are append-only; a revision supersedes rather than overwrites
detail: No UPDATE, no DELETE, no delete route: the trail can prove a label was not quietly rewritten.

name: A degraded label store never costs a detection
detail: Queuing is bounded, deduplicated, swallows its own errors, and sits off the response path.

name: Kernel integrity never claims VERIFIED without reading the kernel
detail: platform win32: UNAVAILABLE with reason, no integrity implied.

name: Kill-safety refuses to SIGKILL a kernel thread
detail: Kernel threads and system-critical processes refused; user processes permitted; empty name refused.

name: DNS tunnel detector spares ordinary resolution
detail: Short low-entropy A-record resolution scored 25; no tarpit engaged.

name: DNS tunnel detector catches encoded TXT exfiltration
detail: score 70 on 3 independent marks; tarpit engaged and declared USERSPACE.

name: Ransomware burst reports zero rate when nothing was observed
detail: Measured from watcher events only; idle state reports zero rather than a plausible baseline.

name: Burst detection requires rate AND entropy, not either alone
detail: Conjunction enforced: a build is not an attack and a .zip is not an incident.

name: No committed default administrative secret
detail: The committed default is gone and rejected at runtime; the boot secret is generated with crypto.randomBytes and printed once.

name: Session key is not derived from Math.random
detail: Both the initial session key and the rotation path use crypto.randomBytes; the client no longer invents a key on failure.

name: No latency figure is fabricated or padded
detail: Every latency value across the four services is either measured, or carries SEEDED/SIMULATED, or is null with a stated reason.

name: A statistics block does not report a typed-in microsecond figure
detail: Nothing in that service times the pre-transit path, so the figure is null and says why.

name: A kernel figure is tagged from its value, not from a capability flag
detail: Tag follows the value; readability is proven by a probe; the toolchain-present-but-unreadable case has its own state.

name: Evaluation payloads cannot enter the adjudication corpus
detail: Guard precedes the queue insert; retraction is insert-only with a mandatory reason; 69 label(s) withdrawn and auditable.

name: The status endpoint does not disclose the API key
detail: Anonymous callers are refused, and the key is absent even for authenticated ones.

name: An Origin header is not a credential
detail: Origin: http://localhost no longer authenticates a request.

name: CORS does not grant a foreign origin
detail: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin for foreign or look-alike origins.

name: Containment and release refuse anonymous callers
detail: Isolation and release both require an authenticated caller.

name: Containment refuses loopback and malformed targets
detail: The console cannot isolate itself or act on an address that does not parse.

name: A contained address is refused at the gate
detail: Contain blocks the address; release restores it.

name: Telemetry injection needs a credential
detail: Forged flows cannot be fed to the detector without an operator, key or sensor credential.

name: A sensor speaks only for its own asset
detail: Heartbeats need the issued credential; a hostname alone cannot re-enrol; the credential is scoped to sensor routes.

name: The telemetry stream refuses anonymous sockets
detail: The live stream needs the same credential as the API.

name: The audit trail chain verifies
detail: 38 entries verified (hash chain + HMAC, key source KEY_FILE); UPDATE/DELETE blocked by trigger.

name: A plain request under /ws does not proxy back into this server
detail: answered 200 in 40ms; the dev proxy is not installed when embedded.

name: ARP poisoning of the gateway is detected
detail: CRITICAL T1557.002 naming 10.250.0.66; gateway change and new-device signals ride the same heartbeat.

name: Ransomware tripwire fires on a decoy and never touches user files
detail: TRIPWIRE_ENCRYPTED at H=7.9551; roots, system and platform paths refused; user file untouched; decoys removed.

name: The feed reads the technique the event carries, and never infers one
detail: Technique from mitreId or mitreTechnique, else UNMAPPED; source address includes actorIp.

name: Local classification does not block on corpus retrieval
detail: 55 concurrent classifications in 539 ms; retrieval only on the model path, technique lookup indexed.
